individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution microscopy reconstructions (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a summary plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows super-resolution microscopy reconstructions, not a summary plot of averaged data.
Scatter/dot plot of number of clusters per cell shows mean +/- SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter/dot plot of cluster sizes shows mean +/- SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Scatter/dot plot of percentage of molecules in clusters shows mean +/- SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows super-resolution reconstructions and trajectories, not a summary plot of averaged data.
Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement traces; both plot types are exempt from requiring individual data point overlay.
Panel H shows trajectories and a kymograph, not a summary plot of averaged data.
